rappel_detail.anchor: old fixed anchor, not maintained; inspect and back up with your own sling or cord
rappel_detail.station: The summit of Ares Tower, above the short low-5th-class step.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel down the step to the notch where gear is stashed. The rest of the descent downclimbs 4th-class ridge.

set.descent: Rappel once from the Ares Tower summit to the notch, reverse the 4th-class ridge, and descend the Burgundy Col approach back to Early Winters Creek.
